cases.name: test-handle-quotes-normal-single
cases.description: Verifies that single quotes group words with spaces into a single token.
cases.expected_behavior: The input string containing single-quoted sections produces a unified argument without outer quotes.

cases.name: test-handle-quotes-normal-double
cases.description: Verifies that double quotes group words with spaces into a single token.
cases.expected_behavior: The input string containing double-quoted sections produces a unified argument without outer quotes.

cases.name: test-handle-quotes-edge-empty
cases.description: Verifies handling of empty quoted strings within the input stream.
cases.expected_behavior: Empty quotes result in an empty argument token rather than disappearing entirely.

cases.name: test-handle-quotes-dynamic-mixed
cases.description: Verifies correct behavior with a combination of unquoted, single-quoted, and double-quoted parameters.
cases.expected_behavior: All argument boundaries are correctly identified regardless of quote types.
cases.expected:
echo
hello
wide world
from program
